##Test Programs
* alternate-blink.fxc:	blinks USER0 and USER1 LEDs alternately, speed varies with PLL_RANGE selection
* alternate-blink.hx:  assembled version of above
* both-led-on.fxc:  sets both USER0 and USER1 LEDs on
* both-led-on.hex:  assembled version of above
* sola.fxc:  SOLA pitch shifter, -1 to +1 octave on POT0, mix on POT1, snapped to semitones from a table in MR7..MR31 unless SW0 is on (USER0 lit while snapping); generated by gen-sola.js, measured by assembler/sim-test/test-sola.js
* sola.fxl:  the same shifter as a library subroutine, @sola.shifter(in, pitch, out, mbase), 16 MREGs from mbase; generated by gen-sola.js alongside sola.fxc
* reverse-delay.fxc:  forward/reverse delay after US 9,899,013 (EarthQuaker Devices), runs up to 16K samples on POT0, repeats on POT1, mix on POT2, SW0 held is forward; measured by assembler/sim-test/test-reverse.js
* allpass-chorus.fxc:  two-voice chorus reading its taps with INTERP or Dattorro's all-pass interpolator, rate on POT0, depth on POT1, mix on POT2, SW0 toggles INTERP / all-pass (USER0), SW1 toggles warped / plain coefficient (USER1)
